results.content: Therefore, the study examines Taiwan’s western offshore wind farm (OWF) area and develops a precautionary area (PA) planning model. By integrating AIS, MGIS, and FLC, the study develops an alternative PA planning model that enhances navigational and ecological safety while planning offshore wind farms. This study utilizes vessel traffic density data derived from AIS in western Taiwan to assess the feasibility of the PA in the offshore area of Taichung Harbor and the OWF waters. However, since the Changhua Offshore Wind Farm channel currently lacks a mandatory vessel navigation regulation, and the AIS data compiled in this study did not filter the vessels’ headings, it is not possible to confirm if ships are sailing against the channel or crossing into the Offshore Wind Farm area. The proposed FLC model for PA planning in this study can be adapted for use in other ports or offshore wind farms worldwide by modifying data and parameters, such as traffic density, ecological environment, and hydrological conditions.

results.title: From macro to micro: A multi-scale method for assessing coastal ...
results.content: The main findings are as follows: (1) as of June 2024, 6516 offshore wind turbines (OWTs) have been installed along China’s coastline, with an average installation depth of 14.8 m and an average distance of 32.7 km from the coast; (2) wake effect areas are approximately three times the size of the wind farm areas, with significantly larger wake areas observed in southern sea regions; (3) the Taiwan Strait is identified as the most suitable region for wind farm development; (4) integration of macro-scale with micro-scale assessment not only enhances general understanding of wind resources but also captures details in local regions. Offshore wind energy resource assessments are typically categorized into two types: macro-scale assessment (thousands of kilometers) with low resolution, providing a general understanding of wind resources over large areas; and micro-scale assessment (tens to hundreds of kilometers) with high resolution, capturing detailed data in localized regions.
